summary: Iteration 143 - Tooltip Visibility & CTA Tracking Testing. Backend APIs pass (9/9). CRITICAL: Dark mode tooltip has low contrast (dark text on dark bg) due to CSS minification bug in build.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL P0 BLOCKER: Dark mode tooltip has dark text (rgb(17,24,39)) on dark background (rgb(15,23,41)) - text is INVISIBLE. CSS minification corrupted the selector: '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content' became '.bidvex-tooltip-content' in the build, losing the .dark prefix.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix dark mode tooltip CSS - the build has corrupted selectors. In /app/frontend/build/static/css/main.*.css, the rule '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content' was minified incorrectly to '.bidvex-tooltip-content'. Need to rebuild frontend with correct CSS or fix the source CSS to prevent minification issues.
Root cause: CSS minifier merged '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content' with '.bidvex-tooltip-content' incorrectly. Consider using more specific selectors or inline styles to prevent this.
Verify tooltip visibility in dark mode after fix - should have light bg (#f9fafb) and dark text (#111827)
critical_code_review_comments: CSS minification bug: The dark mode tooltip selector '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content' was corrupted during build. The minified CSS shows '.bidvex-tooltip-content,.dark [data-bidvex-tooltip=true]' instead of '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content,.dark [data-bidvex-tooltip=true]'
Light mode tooltip works correctly: dark bg (rgb(15,23,42)) + white text (rgb(255,255,255))
Dark mode tooltip broken: dark bg (rgb(15,23,41)) + dark text (rgb(17,24,39)) = INVISIBLE TEXT
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark mode tooltip visibility is broken due to CSS minification bug. The source CSS in index.css is correct but the build output has corrupted selectors. After fix, verify tooltip shows light bg + dark text in dark mode.

rca_of_the_issue.problem: Dark mode tooltip text is invisible (dark text on dark background)
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: CSS minification during 'yarn build' corrupted the selector '.dark .bidvex-tooltip-content' by removing the '.dark ' prefix, causing the dark mode styles to not apply correctly

rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Rebuild frontend with corrected CSS or use inline styles in the TooltipContent component to force correct colors based on dark mode state
